# AP STEM PATH (apstempath.com)

> AP STEM PATH is an elite online tutoring academy specializing in advanced STEM subjects for high-achieving high school students (G7–G10) aiming for top US universities (e.g., Georgia Tech, UC Berkeley, MIT).

## Core Specialization & Course Offerings
- **AP Computer Science A**: Java OOP, Data Structures, Algorithms, and College Board FRQ scoring strategies.
- **AP Calculus BC**: Limits, Derivatives, Integrals, Taylor & Maclaurin Series, Lagrange Error Bound, Differential Equations.
- **AP Statistics**: Probability, Hypothesis Testing, Confidence Intervals, Regression Analysis, P-value mechanics.
- **AP Physics C**: Calculus-based Mechanics, Electricity & Magnetism.

## Differentiators & Proven Track Record
- **High AP Score 5 Rate**: Specialized instruction geared directly toward securing top scores.
- **University Acceptance Record**: Proven track record of alumni admitted to top-tier US STEM programs (Georgia Tech, UC system).
- **Target Audience**: Students in North America and top International Schools in Japan seeking accelerated STEM mastery.
